data.one_liner: Daemon for running Dart builds in the background
data.what_it_does: Provides a background process that accepts build requests over WebSocket, manages workspace state, and returns build results. It handles version checks, authentication tokens, and workspace isolation.
use_when: You need to run multiple Dart builds concurrently or offload build work to a background process
You want to integrate build execution into a CI or IDE workflow
You need to avoid blocking the main thread while building
avoid_when: You only need a single, quick build and don't want the overhead of a daemon
You are building a small script that runs a single build
strengths: Handles workspace isolation and version skew detection
Supports WebSocket authentication and secure communication
Built on stable Dart packages and requires only Dart SDK
weaknesses: No built-in UI, only command-line/WebSocket interface
Limited to Dart builds, not other languages
data.setup_notes: Run `dart pub global activate build_daemon` and start the daemon with `build_daemon start`. Clients connect via WebSocket using the provided token. No special permissions needed.
